name: budget-brief
title: Marketing budget brief
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM budgets ORDER BY code

sections.title: Campaign commitments
sections.sql: SELECT code,owner,currency,allocation_cents,actual_cents,outstanding_cents,projected_cents,headroom_cents FROM campaign_spend WHERE budget_id=$1 ORDER BY code

name: campaign-review
title: Campaign cost review
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM campaigns ORDER BY code

sections.title: Cost lines
sections.sql: SELECT reference,supplier,currency,planned_cents,committed_cents,actual_cents,forecast_cents,projected_cents FROM line_spend WHERE campaign_id=$1 ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: SELECT note,owner,due_on,resolution FROM actions WHERE campaign_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on
